note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published on PlayStation (via Exophase and PSNProfiles). Guides are written for this entry in our own words; each cites its sources. No trophy needs online play.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the last of the other 54 trophies unlocks — there is nothing extra to do for it. Plan on about 200 hours in total: roughly 60–80 hours of story, around 100 hours on the 100% completion checklist, and about 10 hours of Strangers & Freaks and clean-up. The only trophy that can slip away is Positive Mental Attitude, whose Chapter 1 meditation disappears after Chapter 1, so do that one early and the rest can all be finished in free roam after the story.
steps: Finish the story (Chapters 1–5) and take the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude on the way.
Work the 100% completion checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) until A Long Road unlocks.
Clean up the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands and any leftover trophies — the platinum follows the last one.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish the very first main mission, Gone Fishing, which opens Chapter 1. Just play the story — no side content is needed for it.
steps: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks once you finish Chapter 1 — in practice, when you start the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter (there are 15 manual slots) as cheap insurance, but nothing in Chapter 1 can lock you out of this trophy.
steps: Play through Chapter 1 and start the first mission of Chapter 2.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks once you finish Chapter 2 — when you start the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City. The asterisks in the name come from the game itself.
steps: Play through Chapter 2 and start the first mission of Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks once you finish Chapter 3 — after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 is also where several side-character questlines open (Andy, Randy, Tyrone), so it pays to take the optional missions as they appear, though none of them is needed for this trophy.
steps: Play through Chapter 3 and the first two missions of Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks once you finish Chapter 4 — after its final main mission, Starting From Zero. Chapter 4 is also when the big bank-vault robberies open up (the optional mission That's Where The Money Is…), which feed the Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play trophies later.
steps: Play through Chapter 4 to its final mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss — one of only two golds in the list. It unlocks when you complete the final mission of the story and the credits roll. After that the game continues in free roam with no mission replay, and everything still needed for the platinum stays available.
steps: Play the story to the end and finish the final mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. Just follow the story markers — the mission is mandatory, so the trophy comes with normal progress.
steps: Play the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run to the end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist, one of the story's big set-piece robberies. It is a mandatory mission, so the trophy comes with normal story progress.
steps: Play the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist to the end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. It is a mandatory mission, so the trophy comes with normal story progress.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play to the end.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It is a mandatory mission, so the trophy comes with normal story progress.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners to the end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. It is a mandatory mission, so the trophy comes with normal story progress.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown to the end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory, the last chapter's big operation. It is a mandatory mission, so the trophy comes with normal story progress.
steps: Play the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory to the end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set and the second gold — but the checklist is far more forgiving than it sounds. It opens after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and anything you did during the story already counts. It is closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, collectibles are only partly required, and you only need 70 of the 80 challenges. The only categories that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's Target Decks. Do any 100 optional missions (there are 200–300+), scan any 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles with the WAiNK app, study any 100 of the 255 animals through binoculars, and finish the checklist — the gold pops with it.
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Complete any 100 optional missions (purple icons; black icons with pink letters).
Scan 200 of 277 vehicles (WAiNK app: hold Up, then R1) and study 100 of 255 animals (binoculars: L1, zoom with Up, hold R1).
Finish every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret Target Deck; complete 70 of 80 challenges.
Clear the remaining checklist lines — meditations 15 of 18, stunts 300, card sets and the rest.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps (ramps), 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps (parachute). Mix the categories however you like — flying under bridges is the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts (press R3 on a category), or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road.
steps: Open the map: Exploration (magnifying glass) > Stunt Spots to see found and finished stunts by name.
Do any 250 stunts across the four categories — under-the-bridge flights are fastest.
Keep going to 300 stunts for the 100% completion checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your count under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. You are introduced to most of them through the story and the rest appear as blue dumbbell icons when you unfog the map — in practice this pops on its own while you work on the other trophies and the 100% checklist.
steps: Check Touchpad > Progress > Activities to see which of the 9 types you still need.
Do one of each: fish, hunt, golf, shoot a range, play pool, score a basketball hoop, finish a video game, win any race, do any stunt.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 shooting ranges. The gold-medal scores are not very demanding, and the ranges also level up your Focus — which you need for the Gunslinger trophy. Work through the ranges one by one; every gold is required for this trophy and for the 100% checklist.
steps: Find the 12 shooting ranges (marked when you unfog the map).
Gold every challenge at each range — 42 golds in total.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 drone races in total, three per location. You only need one win at each location for the trophy, but the 100% checklist needs all 42 races won, so plan to finish every location properly. Drone races are also one of the activity types that counts toward Master of None.
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations (marked on the map).
Win at least one race at every location — then win all 42 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race location counts once, so you need 20 distinct wins, not 20 wins of the same race. There are 40 unique race locations across Leonida, so there is plenty of choice. Winning a race also ticks one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
steps: Find race locations on the map (40 unique spots).
Win 20 different ones.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you a fishing location marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge. Fishing itself is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None, so this pulls double duty.
steps: Finish the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal).
Wait for Cal's text with the fishing location, then follow his questline.
Beat Cal in the fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers — you can start in Chapter 1 — and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. To complete a game you must finish all of its levels at least once; you do not need to beat every challenge. Pick whichever game you like best. Playing a video game is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
steps: Go to the TV at home (or an arcade machine for Bang For Your Buck).
Pick a game and finish all of its levels at least once.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline opens automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia: at some point in Chapter 3, while playing as Lucia, Andy calls you and texts her home address, marking the questline in Belville. All of her quests stay available after the story. Complete her 5 quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (join the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van) and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse) — and the trophy pops after the last one.
steps: In Chapter 3 as Lucia, take Andy's call and follow the marker to Belville.
Complete all 5 Andy quests, ending with Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's optional questline opens automatically in Chapter 1: a while after the mission Island Dreams (work for Kenton) he calls you and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you treasure-diving — he marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map, you find the underwater treasure (use the metal detector to dig it from the ocean floor) and bring it back. After the first set he calls you back for more; in total he wants 7 shipwrecks cleared. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees or Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up), so nothing is missable.
steps: After Island Dreams in Chapter 1, follow the KR marker to Kenton in Key Lento.
Dive the marked shipwrecks and bring back the treasure — 7 in total.
Return after each set when Kenton calls; he comes back in Chapters 2–3 if he goes quiet.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline opens automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. All of his quests stay available after the story. Complete his 5 quests — Thrillbillies (check out the mud club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops after the last one.
steps: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, follow the marker to the Thrillbilly Mud Club, Kelly County.
Complete all 5 Billy quests, ending with Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers found in the open world. Only certain questlines count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie and the other named quest-givers do NOT count as strangers for this trophy. The confirmed counting strands are Kirk (Skunk Ape: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?), Yago (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile: Passing the Torch, Backseat Pilot, Pete's Deliveries). All strangers are still there after the story in free roam, and you can see how many you have finished on the trophy tracker.
steps: Find stranger questlines in the open world (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete and more).
Finish 8 complete strands — the named character questlines do not count.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List, opens automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner for breaking into high-end sports cars. Randy then wants 16 sports cars delivered — the Zorrusso is already done as part of the story mission. Track the list under Map > Robberies (money-bag icon) > Randy's Wish List; he marks some cars in fixed locations, but you can also steal them off the street (scan with the WAiNK app to check if a car is on the list, then drive it back to his garage — good condition pays more). Sports cars show up often in east Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around. This can all be done after the story.
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS to unlock the Key Cloner and Randy's list.
Deliver the 16 sports cars on Randy's Wish List to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City).

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline opens automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and is only available as Jason. Purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City — go to the labs and destroy them as part of the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once you have destroyed enough labs, Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down — finish it and the trophy pops. All of this stays available after the story.
steps: After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3 (as Jason), follow the purple Synthetic Labs markers.
Destroy the labs in Take Out Kitty Litter, then complete Spin On This.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE TROPHY THAT MAY BE MISSABLE — do the Chapter 1 meditation before Chapter 1 ends. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Lucia and Jason at a spot counts +2. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The missable one: during Chapter 1, one morning at Jason's house, Lucia says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony — follow her, accept the optional quest when offered, and she shows you how to meditate. It happens after the mission Down to Earth (meet Brian); the exact morning can vary. That meditation raises your counter by 1 but is not marked as a meditation spot like the others, so it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it — PowerPyx's author had done it when the trophy unlocked, so doing it is the safe choice. The final meditation needs both characters playable together, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. For the 100% checklist you only need 15 of 18 meditations.
steps: CHAPTER 1 — DO THIS FIRST: after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation.
Meditate at all 18 spots (10 locations), with both Jason and Lucia at each spot where possible.
Check Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations for what is left.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's optional questline opens automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break: playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted (meet Bret), in Lummox County — Lucia cannot receive the message, so this line is Jason-only. Bret marks hunting spots with purple map icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them back to him as Jason. During the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. One clean shot leaves an animal in pristine condition and pays more, but it is not required. Track the hunts under Map > Activities > Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks in total and all of them are needed for the 100% checklist, so this comes naturally along the way.
steps: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2 (as Jason), take Bret's text and meet him in Lummox County.
Hunt the animals Bret requests at his marked spots and bring them back.
Finish the Target Decks (15 total) — all are needed for 100% anyway.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets — there are 18 sets in total across Leonida, so you only need a fraction of them. Cards are a collectible type you pick up in the world; track sets under your collections progress. Because only 3 of 18 sets are needed, grab the sets whose cards cluster together and leave the scattered ones alone.
steps: Collect cards in the world and complete any 3 full sets (18 sets exist).
Check your collections progress to see which sets are closest to done.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations in the environment — hold Up and then R1 to scan. Any 100 count, and there are far more than 100: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Scan whatever you walk past and this builds up on its own; the same app also scans vehicles for Whip It Good, so the two trophies progress together.
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan objects with R1 as you explore.
Scan any 100 locations — landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags all count.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. There are 10 more than needed for the 100% checklist (which needs 70), so you can skip the hardest ones entirely. View and track them under Progress > Challenges — each shows a Completed checkmark at the bottom right when you scroll over it. Most complete naturally while you work on the other trophies; leave this for near the end, then pick the easiest and quickest of what remains.
steps: Play normally — most challenges complete while chasing other trophies.
Open Progress > Challenges and finish the easiest remaining ones up to 50 (70 for the 100% checklist).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape the heat. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Cause carnage until you reach 4 stars, then escape on a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic; if a helicopter chases you, shoot at it until it leaves. The trophy pops after you drive out of the red heat zone (not just the flashing search area). Easiest route: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. You will also get this automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since the large bank-vault robberies always trigger 4-star wanted levels.
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Raise a 4-star wanted level, then escape — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia is the easiest way out.
The trophy pops once you leave the red heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while keeping your wanted level the whole time. Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break (partner free-roam). Call your partner (hold Right + Triangle), then hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) while staying chased — keep the red/blue flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs (Ammu-Nation) and Zombix/Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: rob a couple of items in each store and ideally break the back-room safe with sticky bombs. The unlock is delayed — it pops about half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop — and if it does not pop, hit a 4th shop and keep going.
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner and gear up (vest, sticky bombs, healing).
Rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level — the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City work well.
Wait ~30 seconds after the 3rd shop; if it does not pop, rob a 4th.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Leonida has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes) and scanning is enough — you never need to drive them. Use the WAiNK app (hold Up to open it instantly), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. You need 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes automatically on the way there.
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan vehicles with R1 — standing on a busy road is fastest.
Discover any 100 vehicles; keep going to 200 base models for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm — time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar (top left, under health and stamina). It only lasts a few seconds, so set it up first: buff your focus with food/drinks or by washing your face/showering at home, and consume Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to extend the focus time. Line up 5 enemies — criminals at gang operations work well — and drop them quickly without missing. Wear body armor (Ammu-Nation) so you can step out of cover, and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556: full-auto and more accurate than pistols or SMGs. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus, purple eye icon); you raise it via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, and you will likely reach level 4 naturally while chasing the other trophies.
steps: Buff focus (food/drinks, Adrenaline) and wear body armor.
Find 5 grouped enemies (gang operations), activate Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming).
Drop all 5 in the one focus window — use a full-auto rifle like the Duke 556.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one sitting on the airfield. The easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight to it (stairs by the boarding bridge lead directly into the plane; you can also walk in through the terminal). Inside, go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the unlock is slightly delayed, so keep flying until it pops.
steps: Go to VCIA and reach the plane docked at terminal E3/E4 (drive through an airfield fence).
Board it, enter the cockpit upstairs, reverse to the airstrip and take off.
Fly at least 1 km away from the airport until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino). The tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, standing in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate — or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance — get into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy unlocks.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station (south-west island, Mariana County).
Enter the base, climb into a Rhino tank in the south of the base and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and jewelry store robberies themselves (green icons, marked automatically in unfogged areas). Then break into a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun: when you approach a locked door you get the prompt to kick it (triggers the alarm) or use the Snap Gun for the stealth approach. The gadget stays in your inventory permanently. Inside, go to the back room, find the note with the safe code, and loot the safe. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun.
Enter a jewelry store's back door with the Snap Gun (do not kick the door).
Find the safe code note in the back room and loot the safe undetected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress and teaches the method: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, a guard carries a briefcase of cash in and the vault opens — go in fast while it is open and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash alone, so bring your partner and hold Right to hand off one bag. After that quest you can pay Yasmani (the fence from Chapter 3) for security-van tips — do his earlier quests first (robbing 2 Payday Loans), then he sells tips for $10,000 and marks the vans with a purple icon. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level; escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this comes automatically — each bank pays up to $205,000, the best endgame money in the game.
steps: Finish That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4 to learn bank-vault robberies.
Buy Yasmani's security-van tips ($10,000) to find vans, or tail vans yourself.
Rob 5 vaults with your partner (hand off a bag with Right) and escape the 4-star heat.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. This unlocks automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — the same mission that opens bank-vault robberies: tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing the vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Escape the red heat radius afterwards (or use a Pay 'n' Spray). You need all 8 large bank jobs for the 100% checklist, so this comes automatically. To get it earlier, block an armored truck driving around Vice City near banks, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests, and Yasmani unlocks as a fence from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. The trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius.
steps: Easiest: do That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4 and rob the vault — it counts.
Or stop an armored truck, sticky-bomb its back door, loot it and escape the heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida — all 52 areas. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged part of the map until the entire map is visible. Exploring also reveals activity icons, ranges, races and collectibles for the other trophies, so it pays to do it early.
steps: Get a plane and fly over every fogged part of the map until nothing is black.
Check the map — all 52 areas must be revealed.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total; for this trophy one per gang is enough, but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so it comes automatically. Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed in the bottom right.
steps: Find illegal gang operations (yellow icons) and rob one for each of the 9 gangs.
Keep going to all 39 operations for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet. As of 18 November 2026 the guide writers list this trophy as unknown — the description points to enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so the likely method is ordering a cocktail at a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, but no source has confirmed the exact spot. Try the bars along Ocean Beach and check back here: this guide is updated as soon as a method is confirmed. Do not trust videos claiming a spot without a second source.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and try the beachfront bars — order a cocktail where you can see the ocean.
No method is confirmed yet; this entry will be updated when one is.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (steal the Zorrusso for Randy) — hack into the car, drive forward through the window, and the trophy pops a little after you drive away on the street. It only unlocks from this specific blue Banshee, not any other car — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
steps: Get the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs.
Go to the showroom in south Vice City, hack the blue Banshee and drive it through the window.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the illegal gang operations. Buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first; you need them to blow the safe. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically. Inside, pick up the 3 valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office (golden icon), the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner (golden icon), and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs). The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item — killing the enemies is not necessary. Not missable: if you do not get all 3 during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long while and you can return for the remaining valuables.
steps: Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation, then go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn.
Take the luxury watch (SE office), the Gutterball shotgun (NE table) and the safe (NE hallway).
Escape the police — the trophy pops after the escape.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia (select a character) > Strength (heart icon). Raise it by working out — buy a fitness-club membership, and always go together with both characters (hold Right and press Triangle to call your partner): while one actively works out, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress. Filter for fitness clubs on Map > Activities (dumbbell icon); there are many across Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.
steps: After Coffee Break, buy a fitness-club membership.
Work out with both characters together (call your partner) until both hit max strength.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on criminal-profile notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) — whenever you do something that affects your reputation, a little demon face appears on the right side of the screen. The profiles run Professional (finishing objectives and robberies stealthily, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating enemies without killing them), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — a permanent status from excessive violence that makes cops more aggressive, so avoid pushing that far. You can see your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. It almost certainly comes passively while you work on the other trophies and the 100% checklist, since every robbery and enemy encounter counts; if it is still short at the end, farming it is as simple as running over civilians and cops with a car.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications).
Play normally — robberies and encounters count toward the 500.
If it is short at the end, farm profile actions (avoid reaching Irredeemable).

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet. As of 18 November 2026 the guide writers list this trophy as unknown — it is believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, and the description ("Second time's the charm") suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, but no source has confirmed the trigger. Do not trust a method that cites only one video or post. This entry will be updated when a method is confirmed by a second source.
steps: No method is confirmed yet; the leading belief ties it to the Payday Loans store from the prologue.
This entry will be updated when a method is confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, and come solo. The spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed: sometimes you will find a blinking car at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy unlocks.
steps: Go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel, Kelly County, after 2AM, alone.
Look for the blinking car; if it is not there, drive away and return.
Follow the path into the woods to the UFO, talk to the abducted woman and walk her back to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet. As of 18 November 2026 the guide writers list this trophy as unknown — it is believed to come from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle (a melee drive-by), but no source has confirmed the exact trigger. Try knocking enemies down with melee attacks from a moving motorcycle and check back here: this entry will be updated when a method is confirmed by a second source.
steps: No method is confirmed yet; the leading belief is kicking enemies down from a moving motorcycle.
This entry will be updated when a method is confirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across all robberies, so you never need $250,000 at once. This comes naturally while you do the robberies for the 100% checklist; the bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but they only open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….
steps: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then deliver marked bills to a fence (Yasmani pays most).
Reach $250,000 in total — bank vaults (up to $205,000 each) get you there fast.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. Leonida has 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores — spending counts across all of them, and normal purchases during the story already contribute.
steps: Spend $100,000 in total across any shops.
Fastest: guns (Ammu-Nation), car mods and tattoos.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are also 4 story-related garages, which do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses) — you get a notification that a new app, Vice City Real Estate, has been installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through that app. A quick way to make the money is robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4. Garages also add parking spots, which you need for the On the Spot trophy.
steps: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2 to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all 8 garages through the app ($160,000 total).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses); it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. You need enough garages first — each garage adds one or more parking spots for registered vehicles (see Little Boxes). Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, and in his garage click Respray and then Register. Moses initially only accepts vehicles without trackers; later, in Chapter 3, you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses down.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses to unlock the Scooter Bros app.
Buy garages first for parking spots, then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn.
Click Respray, then Register — 10 vehicles in total (cheap cars and bikes keep it cheap).
